_about: Fillet-weld rule rows for the LOD Upgrade pack 'Truss welds' (bim-ootb prompts/MODELLER_LOD_UPGRADE_PILL.md section 3 and P2 SPEC; ported from bim-compiler scripts/lod/rebar_defaults.json weld rows). Every row: value, unit, source. source = 'stated: <where the drawing says it>' | 'default: <standard and table>' | 'default: ours (...)' | 'unset: ...'. A stated value always wins over a default, and a row filled in with a 'stated:' source wins over a default. Change a row, re-run; no code change. No project values are kept in this file.

weld_min_table_mm.unit: thinner part up to mm : minimum fillet leg mm

weld_length_rule.value: overlap length along the member axis

weld_contact_end_tol_mm.source: default: ours (an overlap that reaches within this distance of a member end is an end contact)

weld_axis_parallel_max.source: default: ours (largest |member axis . plate normal| for a bead to be laid; above it the member lies across the plate face and the contact is refused, not welded)

plate_thickness_name_pattern.unit: regex on the plate name, group 1 = inches
plate_thickness_name_pattern.source: default: ours (plate names carry 'N" Thickness'; when absent the plate's measured thickness is used)

member_leg_name_pattern.unit: regex on the member name, group 1 = inches
member_leg_name_pattern.source: default: ours (angle names end 'x1/4"'; when absent only the plate thickness governs)

weld_material_gate.unit: words; case-insensitive 'contains' on the element's stated material (material_name or a layer material)
weld_material_gate.source: default: ours (the welded-truss rule applies to steel members and steel plates only)
